filament_notes:
Creality manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 55 C for 12 h.
Manufacturer max speed 600 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed 18 mm3/s matches the manufacturer's rating for this printer.
Product page spec block (US/CA/AU store): 190-230C, hot bed 25-60C, 30-600 mm/s, fan 100%, density 1.25, 1.75+/-0.03 mm, tensile 52.99 MPa, flexural 92.38 MPa, Charpy 8.83 kJ/m2; platforms carbon-silicon, PEI, textured paper, PVP glue. Spool label matches (fan ON). Covers Hyper PLA on paper spool, Hyper PLA RFID (plastic RFID spool for CFS; identical spec block), Spool-Free Hyper PLA RFID refill and all multi-kg packs - same filament, different spool/packaging. Store copy: paper-spool version not recommended in CFS/multi-colour boxes. No drying spec on page; Creality wiki drying guide (generic PLA/PLA-CF row): Creality dryer 55C 8-12h, blast dryer 50-60C 8h; 'suggest' drying, required above 50% RH. Creality slicer profiles: K1 220C/45C bed/300 mm/s/23 mm3/s, K2 Plus 220C/50C bed/23 mm3/s, aux fan 80%.
Source: https://store.creality.com/products/hyper-series-pla-3d-printing-filament-1kg
